text_block_list.text:
On a bitterly cold Christmas Eve, as I was 
working in the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho, Merry Christmaaas!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hard at work, are we? Santa has come to 
visit such a diligent Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Well? Happy?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? There's no such thing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho! This year's Santa has 
'frugality' as his motto.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just having Santa come warmed your heart, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And with that, farewell~!
After some time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho, Merry Christmaaas!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho, Merry Christmaaas!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer looked lonely, so Mayano 
came over to play with you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Spending Christmas with an adult makes 
Maya feel all grown up too, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
True, last year's party was only for the 
dorm members, after all...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's throw a grown-up Christmas 
party! And when you think "grown-up," you 
gotta have a giant turkey!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! It's just like the stuff you see in 
manga! Amazing, amazing! Adults are so 
cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, you're in charge of the 
turkey! We'll get the party pumped up!

Somehow, I ended up playing host to Santa, 
but we had a lively and warm Christmas.
After some time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho, Merry Christmaaas!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Santa will always rise again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You see, this time I brought a proper 
present! Hold on while I get it ready!

Saying that, Tokai Teio began lining up 
several mysterious white bags on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! A present from Santa Teio~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"What's inside this bag is food I made! 
There's a dish in each and every one!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, acting normal isn't any fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, the rule is to eat them in the order 
they're opened! Now, which dish will be 
first, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...To be completely honest, right up until 
just now, I was still torn over what to 
give you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still, seeing you working so hard while 
shivering from the cold, Trainer, made me 
realize this was the one!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't cook much usually, but today is 
special! Come on, eat up, eat up! It'll 
warm you right up~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hahaha!! You pulled the dessert 
cake right off the bat?!

Thanks to Santa Teio's surprise, I spent a 
Christmas that warmed both body and soul.
